author: Yffe
content: Fix the two interlocking causes. #232 weave: forge::check item_subprogram Struct/Enum arm now weaves adt_deps + spec_items + item (mirroring the Fn arm) so the named spec fn def reaches lowering and the per-item spec_fn_param_type_map is non-empty (restores #229 REQ-5 as-u32 cast off the as-u64 fallback). #230 visibility: thermite-lower emits pub open spec fn for user spec fns; class-completed by pub enum (lower_enum) and pub open on generated scheme fns (<e>_len, fold_<e>/for_all_<e>) — all reachable from a pub open well_formed body. Goldens regenerated prefix-only (R-CHAR-3). Un-ignore the pin.
